title: AUTH4 gate records (#983 r2 / #984 r2 / #986 / #987): H-limiter MACHINE_AUTH_METHODS never meets the oauth label, stale scopes.ts:125-126 docblock, H-mounts "eight" is seven, ks1151 test-quality R-C1/R-C2 + R-C3 wording, forward-only refresh window (deployment-side)
description:
## BLUF

The open Records the AUTH4 tier-1 gate read or measured while gating PR #983 r2 (KS-823), PR #984 r2 (KS-835), PR #986 (KS-1151) and PR #987 (KS-1150 R-1) on 2026-09-14 — **none a finding at Minor or above against any of the four deltas; all four verdicts GO WITH FINDINGS, OVERALL GO WITH FINDINGS.** Filed as ONE ticket on Wednesday's brief to the merge seat (03:44:52Z, ITEM 5) so each record is searchable by symbol/path and none is rediscovered as new. #983 r2 landed as M31 `b9f541e6b`, #984 r2 as M32 `2c3315f37`; #986 / #987 follow on their stack seat merge-ins.

Report: `/Volumes/DevMASTER/!CODING/Testing Agent MAIN/projects/secuura/reports/2026-09-14-ks823-835-1151-1150-AUTH4-5b0f4dd58-9b020ff82-ac1c119b5-b6ed60f3b-tier1-r1/report.md` (246 lines, 13:28 AEST; §2 d, §3.5, §3.7, §8, §9). Measured on develop M29 `4569dd889` (the report's own numbering calls it "M24" — it did not count Kam's five merge commits).

**Search before filing (every KS issue incl. archived, 1,145 issues, title + description + comments, literal match;** `5_Project_History/2026-09-14_s225/item5/symbol_search.log`**):** `MACHINE_AUTH_METHODS` → comments only (KS-1150 `0d94fde8`, KS-835); `validateScopes` → **KS-839 (Backlog, live) is the existing home of the H-wildcard record — it is NOT re-filed here, only related**; `scopes.ts:125` → comments only; `requireScope` → 16 issues, none this record; `JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN` → 0; `ks1151` → KS-1150's comment only; `forward-only window` → 0; `oauth_app` → 21 issues, the H-limiter ancestor among them is **KS-164 (Done, archived — named here, no relation)**: "API-key clients aren't rate-limited — `rateLimitEnforce.ts:21`". Controls: a known title hits 1, a nonsense term 0.

**Not this ticket:** R-2 / R-3 (the OAuth refresh grant rotates/denylists nothing; OPEN on KS-1150 — its own DoD) · H-wildcard (KS-839) · KS-1152 (L5 records) · KS-1153 (L7 records) · KS-1150's own #982 records.

## The records, each with its symbol/path

### A. From #984 r1/r2 (KS-835) — READ, open, UNEDITED at `06aafd51c` (report §2 c–d)

1. **H-limiter.** `services/api-gateway/src/middleware/rateLimitEnforce.ts:61` `MACHINE_AUTH_METHODS = new Set(['api_key','oauth_app'])` — nothing mints `'oauth_app'`; an OAuth-minted token now carries `authMethod: 'oauth'` (KS-835), so the machine-client limiter's label set and the mint's label do not meet. Archived ancestor: KS-164.
2. **The stale** `scopes.ts:125-126` **docblock.** `services/api-gateway/src/middleware/scopes.ts:125-126` still says "KS-835 records that OAuth-minted tokens carry the `email` label too" — no longer true after #984; the comment describes the pre-fix world. Still there at `ac1c119b5`.
3. **H-mounts "eight" is seven.** `services/api-gateway/src/routes/proxy.ts`: `requireScope(` ×6 (`:375 :394 :568 :575 :764 :770`) + `requireScopeOrRole(` ×1 (`:731`) = SEVEN scope-gated mounts. "eight" remains in the PR #984 body (2 hits), two KS-835 comments and the gateway test `ks835-oauth-token-scope-gate.test.ts:59` comment. Polish.
4. **H-wildcard** (`validateScopes`, `services/auth/src/services/oauth.ts:352` `if (allowed.includes('*')) return requested;`) — **home: KS-839**; listed here only so the AUTH4 index is complete.

### B. From #986 (KS-1151) — MEASURED, test-quality Polish against the PR's OWN tests, not the guard (report §3.5)

* **R-C1 (T5):** the shipped suite records `world.sessionLookups` (`:64`, `:82`) but no cell asserts it (30 `expect(` lines, 0 on `sessionLookups`) — the "before `getSession`" claim is pinned by the comment and the PR text, not by the suite. Described regression cell: C3 of `evidence/__qa1151_launder.test.ts` (assert `getSession` = 0 on the refusal). Tamper T5 (guard moved below `getSession`): the builder's 5 cells STAY GREEN; the gate's C3/C6/C7 go red.
* **R-C2 (T6/T7):** every OAuth fixture in the shipped file carries `client_id` (cells 1/2 both claims, cell 3 `client_id` only), so the `authMethod === 'oauth'` arm has NO earning cell — it can be dropped (T6) or case-broken (T7) and the suite stays green. Described regression cell: C7 (re-sign minus `client_id`, keep the label → 401).
* **R-C3 (Polish, message text):** the guard's 401 body is `InvalidCredentialsError`'s default `"Invalid email or password"` (C1/C2/C6/C7), while a garbage/access token reads `"Invalid token"` (C8). The route's other two `InvalidCredentialsError` sites (`:663` absent token, `:687` no session) say the same words, so it is the route's own idiom and `logger.warn` carries the reason for operators — but an integrator whose OAuth SDK hits this route by mistake is told about an email and a password. Not a defect in #986; a wording the owner may want to unify.
* File: `services/auth/src/__tests__/ks1151-auth-refresh-refuses-oauth-token.test.ts`; guard: `services/auth/src/routes/auth.ts` after `verifyRefreshToken`, before `getSession` (`client_id !== undefined || authMethod === 'oauth'` → 401).

### C. THE FORWARD-ONLY WINDOW — escalation candidate, deployment-side, Kam via Wednesday (report §3.7; NOT a grade on #986)

A refresh token minted at the OAuth grant BEFORE #983/#984 land carries NEITHER `client_id` NOR `authMethod` and therefore passes the guard and still launders at `/api/auth/refresh` until it expires (`JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN` default `'7d'`, `services/auth/src/services/jwt.ts:44`). The deployed population is UNMEASURED (both round-1 reports, both PR bodies and this pass agree — no environment was probed). The instrument that closes the window is deployment-side (denylist the pre-deploy OAuth refresh jtis, or force re-authorisation at deploy). Also by design: a refused OAuth token is NOT denylisted by the sibling (C3 proves it stays alive at its own grant) — its replay protection is the OAuth grant's own `isRefreshJtiDenylisted` read (`oauth.ts:923`), which rotates/denylists nothing on success → R-2, open on KS-1150.

## §8 FINDINGS INDEX (evidence class · severity · target · SHIPS-WITH or TICKET) — verbatim

* **None at Minor or above against any of the four deltas.**
* R-C1 · MEASURED (T5) · Polish/test-quality · #986 · described regression cell C3 (assert `getSession` 0 on the refusal) — SHIPS-WITH as a follow-up test, not a blocker.
* R-C2 · MEASURED (T6/T7) · Polish/test-quality · #986 · described regression cell C7 (label-only token → 401) — SHIPS-WITH as a follow-up test.
* R-C3 · MEASURED · Polish/message text · #986 (route idiom, pre-existing) · owner's call.
* FORWARD-ONLY WINDOW · RULED consequence · deployment-side · Kam via Wednesday (escalation candidate, not a finding against #986).
* R-2 / R-3 · READ · open · KS-1150 (TICKET stays open after #987).
* #984 r1 Records: H-limiter · stale `scopes.ts:125-126` docblock · H-wildcard · H-mounts "eight" (seven) · READ · open · KS-835 / a follow-up ticket.
* Brief-precision (Wednesday's): END-state test FILES = 55 on M20 / 59 on M24, not 54; the oauth.ts `:852/:958` sites are `:848/:954` at `ac1c119b5`; the launcher's develop arm refuses at M24 (GUARDED) — the merge seat re-pins deliberately.

## §9 CLOSING — what the gate wants acted on — verbatim

1. Merge seat: the ADDENDUM at the top, re-pinned on the develop you land on (M24 or later); expected END tree `055e65485` on M24, auth 59/734.
2. Kam (via Wednesday): the forward-only window (§3.7) — decide the deployment-side instrument (denylist pre-deploy OAuth refresh jtis / forced re-auth), population unmeasured.
3. Owner (s221 or successor): two described regression cells for the ks1151 file (C3 ordering, C7 label-only); R-2 / R-3 on KS-1150; the four #984 Records.
4. Nothing else. No environment was touched; nothing was pushed, commented, filed or merged; scratch quarantined by rename under my scratchpad (`gate.KgDanL/quarantine/`, 20 items); the checkout and the builder's four worktrees read porcelain 0 at start and close.

## Definition of done

One test pass, per Kam's 2026-09-07 rule: A.1–A.3 edited (the limiter's label set decided, the docblock rewritten, "eight" → seven in the test comment; the PR body and ticket comments are history and stay), B's two described cells added to the ks1151 file (C3, C7) and R-C3 decided, C ruled by Kam (deployment-side; recorded here or on its own ticket if it becomes work). A.4 closes with KS-839; R-2/R-3 close with KS-1150.

Filed by the merge seat s225 on 2026-09-14 after #984's squash (M32 `2c3315f37`), before KS-835's archive, so KS-835's closing comment can name it.

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** Second landing; first delivered to KS-1157 by s225. Ruling delivered for item C of this ticket (the forward-only refresh window). Kam ruled on 2026-09-14 14:53:29 AEST (card `secuura-oauth-refresh-window-iat-cutoff-or-marker`): option **marker-only**, "(B) add the OAuth session marker now; accept the current 7-day window". Card detail as recorded: "Selective denylists become possible for future deploys; today's pre-fix tokens expire on their own."

Left open: this ticket's definition of done still names "the limiter's label set decided, the docblock rewritten" (A.1 and A.2), "B's two described cells added to the ks1151 file (C3, C7)", "R-C3 decided" and "R-2/R-3 close with KS-1150"; none is shown delivered on this ticket (its comment of 2026-11-03T23:11Z).

**BLUF:** Delivered: PR 1162 merged as 3685616782ff (R-C2: POST /api/auth/refresh refuses a label-only OAuth refresh token) and PR 1146 (64ab105132ea, A3, comment-only) on develop; PR 1162 has no deploy surface (tests only: its one file). Left open: the definition of done on this ticket also names A.1 and A.2, B's two cells (C3 and C7), a decision on R-C3 and a ruling on C, none shown delivered on the ticket, and says R-2 and R-3 close with KS-1150, whose R-2 and R-3 are still undelivered (see the comment on KS-1150).
